final: WITH step1 AS (SELECT t.tradekind AS trader_type, COUNT(DISTINCT r.transreg) AS transaction_count FROM advancedbehavior AS a JOIN transactionrecord AS r ON r.transreg COLLATE BINARY = a.translink COLLATE BINARY JOIN trader AS t ON t.tradereg COLLATE BINARY = r.trdref COLLATE BINARY GROUP BY t.tradekind), step2 AS (SELECT SUM(transaction_count) AS total_count FROM step1), step3 AS (SELECT trader_type, transaction_count, CAST(transaction_count AS REAL) / NULLIF(total_count, 0) AS share FROM step1 CROSS JOIN step2 WHERE total_count IS NOT NULL), step4 AS (SELECT AVG(share) AS average_share FROM step3) SELECT trader_type, transaction_count, share, share - average_share FROM step3 CROSS JOIN step4 WHERE average_share IS NOT NULL AND share > average_share
